item.title: Haitians cheer El Salvador’s Bukele amid gang war
item.description: Some Haitians have cheered on El Salvadorian troops deployed to fight gangs in the Haitian capital.

item.title: Plane clips truck during emergency landing on busy Florida road
item.description: A small plane has made an emergency landing on a busy Florida road, much to the shock of drivers.

item.title: Drone attack on Colombian army base kills three soldiers and wounds 16
item.description: Colombian President de la Espriella says those behind the attack in Santa Rosa del Sur will have ‘nowhere to hide’.

item.title: Earthquake hits central Japan, injuring more than 20 people
item.description: The magnitude 5.7 quake hit Shizuoka prefecture, and authorities warn of possible strong aftershocks in coming days.

item.title: Trump asks UFC chief Dana White to be White House press secretary
item.description: Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO says he will meet with the US president on Monday to discuss the offer.

item.title: Egypt sacks winning football coach after wives’ scandal
item.description: The Egyptian Football Association has sacked national team coach Hossam Hassan, cutting short a promising tenure.

item.title: US launches task force to disrupt Iran’s land-based supply routes
item.description: The operation is to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport weapons and other materials, US says.

item.title: Canary Islands’ El Hierro declares emergency amid migrant, refugee influx
item.description: El Hierro asks Spanish government for help after more than 3,300 people arrived on boats since start of November.
